Shared product architecture: one uniform M.shell() manager grammar + a generic resource-row helper render all 35 managers (10 baseline + 25 final-cumulative families); every action is functional via a single generic handler (no decorative controls).

Provider coverage: the Provider/Account/Model/Installation manager (core, in every concept) carries all 17 packet fixtures incl. 8 installation-lifecycle rows (5 confidence levels, 7 update states), the CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary, requested/effective routes, Free Models setup, and catalog last-known-good freshness.

Required design qualities honored across all four: no filter pills as primary destinations (owned strip + destination panels/regions/rows/sections), compact single-action notices, no left accent borders (status via circular dots), no emoji (SVG only), no clipped text, no fake data, no decorative controls.

Slint 1.17.1 portability: semantic state is kept separate from DOM geometry throughout (active-sub, expanded, theme, reduced-motion in PM.state); residual port risks are virtualization of long lists, the IntersectionObserver scrollspy mechanism, and FLIP/smooth-scroll motion (all have portable reduced-motion fallbacks).

Shared process rules honored: no SQLite; no Playwright terminology (PM-native Browser Program only); native Windows complete without WSL; CLI-owned OAuth boundary respected; provider CLI initial acquisition explicit/official-source; SQLite remains prohibited.

showcase_pass_2026_08_15.purpose: Showpiece polish layer: 'showpiece under strict packet-calm' — every motion is interaction- or state-driven, idle screens are perfectly still, pointer reactivity is the differentiator. This layer is explicitly SEPARATE from packet compliance: no packet claim, coverage entry, or correction statement was changed; correction_2026_08_13 above remains the compliance record.
motion_law_honored: Film-level means directed choreography, not constant movement: idle-silence is a tested guarantee (zero running getAnimations() on every Home after 2.1s idle)
No indefinite attention pulse: all pulses/badges/pops are one-shot on state change
Establish spatial origin: M.captureOrigin records the clicked control; stage entrances radiate from it
No text animated before layout is stable: boot sequences and staggers start post-layout; text reveals use settle-then-text
Reduced motion preserves every state and action: pointer FX, tilt, springs, wakes, and staggers all have state-only paths (probe-verified inert)
No browser-only physics: spring is bounded (force-settle) and state-driven; no arbitrary DOM measurements at animation time beyond the origin snapshot
engine_additions: M.captureOrigin/M.clearOrigin — spatial-origin stage transitions (--pm-origin-x/y; swapStage entrances radiate from the clicked control, zoom variant scales from origin)
M.spring — critically-damped rAF spring with hard force-settle (≤1100ms), used for Atlas pin drop, viewport thumb follow, magnetic returns

M.pointerFX — delegated rAF-throttled pointer reactivity: cursor glow (--mx/--my), ≤1.5° tilt (--tilt-x/y on data-pm-tilt cards), magnetic press on buttons; gated on (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine), inert under reduced motion, paused when hidden
Theme-scaled pacing: --pm-motion-scale (friendly/glass 1.0, basic 0.85, retro 0.8) multiplying the --t-* duration tokens
Micro-choreography: toast icon+label in/out, chip settle, sprout badge pop, one-shot ⌘K search breathe

Unified field focus language (2026-08-16 polish check): accent border + 3px --accent-soft ring on every field surface (shared .field, Atlas Cmd+K, Stack/Stream search — previously border-tint only), transition-aware, state-only under reduced motion
